description: Open and flowing. Well-lit throughout. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living, kitchen on side wall. Seating: sofa along upper area facing into the living space and toward the TV wall on the right. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall right of entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is living area, L-shaped corridor, short. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via own door off corridor, walk-in wardrobe (enclosed with door). Master suite (en-suite bathroom) at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: large families needing multiple bedrooms; households requiring a home office with a dedicated desk; roommates wanting separate private bedrooms.
not_suitable_for: households requiring a home office with a dedicated desk
